nism_exception_scope: NISM may use market price data with a one-day lag only for its simulation lab. IPO Reality Lab is not NISM and does not claim this exception.
scope_note: The 30-day restriction concerns sharing and usage of market price data for educational and awareness activities. It is not a blanket 30-day embargo on public offer documents, RHPs, prospectuses or issuer / exchange filings.
